def right_lane():

    move("right", "1d58d45f58c932f071ca9641505e7a0a5abb03f7ed0d96b9aad5a93383fd32ea")

brief_author_note: This program performs a synchronized left-to-right handover by approaching in parallel, having the right arm grasp, transferring authority, releasing the left grasp, and retreating.
